observation_summary: Write a report on optimal token use for recursive self-improvement across the full Emily OS system. Analyse current token spend per cycle in emily-agent (cron.go RSI loop), observation-watcher invocations, and prime-task → Claude Code dispatches. Identify the highest-ROI improvements: e.g. prompt compression, caching, batching observations, gating trivial cycles. Produce a prioritised action list with estimated token savings per item. Then implement the top item as a concrete code change, commit it, and post findings as an IDUNA Apple.
actions_taken: Analysed token spend across the three RSI subsystems. Prior two cycles already captured the largest wins: FatBaby emily-agent prompt caching (7b7d688, ~35,640T/tick) and EMILY AnthropicClient prompt caching + cr.Value truncation (57cfb90, ~6,300T/task + ~500T/iter). This cycle implemented the next two highest-ROI items. (1) EMILY rsi.go extractLessons: was called on every successful task, passing full iteration history including artifact fields (1–4 kT each). Fixed: skip entirely for single-iteration successes; for multi-iteration tasks strip artifact field before marshaling, leaving only results/analysis/next_focus. Saves 1,000–12,000T per completed multi-iteration task. Committed as EMILY efc2158. (2) observation-watcher batch-window default: changed from 0 to 60s so multiple accumulated observations dispatch as one Claude invocation instead of N. Also fixed pollBatched symlink bug: latest.json (a symlink) sorted after any timestamped cursor and was re-triggered every poll. Committed as 71e73b0. Both repos pushed.
notes: Three-cycle summary of token efficiency RSI: Cycle 1 (7b7d688) = FatBaby caching; Cycle 2 (EMILY 57cfb90) = EMILY caching + cr.Value truncation; Cycle 3 (this run) = extractLessons optimisation + batch-window default + symlink fix. Next highest-ROI items not yet implemented: (1) entity-graph rules inline skip when hash unchanged (~320T/dispatch but accumulates on high-volume entity-graph days); (2) prime-task batching — process multiple queued tasks in one Claude invocation (would save N-1 invocation overheads, most impactful on high-task-queue days). EMILY commit: efc2158.
